# SEOPage

> SEOPage (seopage.com) sells done-for-you SEO pages. A customer gives us a
> target keyword; we research the search results, write the page, structure it
> for search engines, review it by hand, and deliver one ready-to-publish HTML
> file — within 3 hours, for $99 per page.

Key facts:
- Product: one finished SEO page per order (not software, not an audit, not a draft)
- Price: $99 per page, one-time; no subscription
- Delivery: emailed within 3 hours of ordering
- Every page includes: search-intent research, competitor analysis, title tag,
  meta description, H1–H3 structure, full written copy, an FAQ section,
  schema markup, internal-link recommendations, and human review
- Pages are engineered for both Google rankings and AI search citations
  (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
- Audience: local businesses, small businesses, SaaS, and agencies (white-label
  and volume orders via support@seopage.com)

## Pages

- [Home — Done-for-you SEO pages](https://seopage.com/): the offer, what's
  included, how it works, pricing, and FAQ
- [On-page SEO services](https://seopage.com/on-page-seo-services): what
  on-page SEO services include, what they cost, and how a done-for-you page
  compares to audits and tools
- [What is an SEO landing page?](https://seopage.com/seo-page): reference
  guide — anatomy, types, history, and how AI search changed SEO pages
